answers.title: Azure Functions on AKS: three ways to trigger on a blob upload
answers.question: Which way of triggering Azure Functions on AKS after a blob upload (the polling Blob trigger, Event Grid to a Storage queue, or Event Grid to Service Bus) works best with private networking, identity-only access and KEDA scaling, and at what latency, cost and operational effort?
answers.time_box: 3 phases, stop and report after each
answers.author: Iheb Khemissi
